citation: Vehring, Pharmaceutical particle engineering via spray drying, Pharm. Res. 2008, 25(5):999-1022
notes: Origin of the Peclet framework used here: Pe = evaporation rate / (8 x liquid-phase diffusivity), with the evaporation rate defined by the d-squared law. Low Pe gives dense particles near true density; high Pe gives surface enrichment and hollow, dimpled or wrinkled particles. NOTE: automated extraction of this equation from rendered HTML produces dimensionally impossible variants - check dimensions by hand.
